name: Nitro Open-Source Server Toolkit
free_limit: MIT-licensed server toolkit/framework for local development and building deployable web/serverless applications; no Nitro software license fee or vendor-imposed local build quota.
watch_out: Nitro does not provide free hosted compute, domains, bandwidth, CI or databases; cloud/serverless provider billing and overage policies apply. The upstream main branch documents Nitro v3 while Nitro v2 remains the current stable line; check version compatibility and runtime adapters.
